genre: casual merge-3 puzzle and sky-city restoration

visual_truth.render_style: polished colorful 2D casual mobile-game art with chunky readable objects
visual_truth.characters: cute small witches with oversized pointed hats, friendly faces and compact proportions
visual_truth.world: floating grass islands, garden paths, clouds, magical fog and restoration

gameplay_truth: show exactly three identical source objects for a merge-3 claim
the three source objects must be visually separate and easy to count
keep the board and object scale readable on a phone
brand_invariants: title must read exactly MERGE WITCHES
the advertised result must be a witch, creature or object plausible in the product
the image must look like the same product family as the official screenshots
forbidden: generic dark gothic poster with no gameplay board
two-object merge presented as real gameplay
four or more source objects when the claim is merge three
weapons or combat as the central mechanic
